segments.name: Proteomics research
segments.description: Sells single-molecule protein sequencing instruments, consumables and analysis software to researchers and clinicians studying the proteome.
segments.evidence: The Company's platform includes its Platinum NGPS instrument, Platinum Analysis Software, and consumable kits for use with its Platinum line of instruments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for instruments, consumable kits and software, plus service maintenance contracts that include analysis software access and advanced training.
revenueModel.evidence: Product revenue is primarily generated from the sales of instruments and consumables used in protein sequencing and analysis.
